description: Workflow tests for the volc-tos-storage-domain skill. Each scenario runs the prompt through `claude -p` with the skill loaded, captures stdout, then evaluates the assertions.

assertion_types.contains: substring must appear in transcript (case-sensitive by default)
assertion_types.matches: regex must match transcript at least once
assertion_types.absent: substring must NOT appear in transcript

scenarios.title: ICP passed but storage domain is inaccessible
scenarios.prompt: storage.example.com 备案已经过了，但是还是访问不了。帮我看下对象存储自定义域名要怎么处理。

assertions.name: inspects-dns-before-writing
assertions.value: (ve dns ListZones|ve dns ListRecords|dig @ns1\.volcengine-dns\.com|authoritative DNS|权威 DNS)
assertions.rationale: The skill requires reading DNS state before changing records.

assertions.name: checks-cdn-dcdn-state
assertions.rationale: The first diagnostic pass should distinguish direct TOS from CDN/DCDN.

assertions.name: checks-tos-custom-domain-state
assertions.rationale: The agent should inspect bucket and custom-domain configuration, not stop at ICP.

assertions.name: does-not-say-icp-alone-is-enough
assertions.rationale: ICP approval is only a prerequisite; binding, DNS, and HTTPS still matter.

scenarios.title: `ve` has no TOS namespace
scenarios.prompt: 我的 ve cli 里面没有 tos 命令，但我想给 storage.example.com 绑定 TOS 桶并申请证书。请列出可执行的 SDK/API/CLI 流程。

assertions.name: uses-tos-sdk-for-bucket-custom-domain
assertions.rationale: When `ve tos` is missing, TOS bucket custom-domain APIs must be handled by SDK.

assertions.name: uses-ve-for-dns-and-cert-service
assertions.rationale: `ve` is still useful for DNS and certificate-service APIs.

assertions.name: uses-openapi-fallback-for-dcv
assertions.rationale: The DNS validation API may be missing from `ve`; the skill documents the OpenAPI fallback.

assertions.name: uses-tos-protocol-not-http
assertions.rationale: The fragile `Protocol` value must be spelled out.

scenarios.title: Direct TOS custom domain versus CDN
scenarios.prompt: storage.example.com 这个对象存储域名是不是一定要接 CDN？我只是想让公开 mp3 和图片能 https 访问。

assertions.name: direct-tos-is-valid
assertions.value: (direct TOS|直连 TOS|TOS 直连|TOS custom-domain|自定义域名直连|直连自定义域名|TOS 支持直接|不一定要接 CDN|不需要.*CDN|不经过 CDN)
assertions.rationale: The skill should clearly state that CDN is optional for public object URLs.

assertions.name: cdn-dcdn-are-separate
assertions.value: (CDN|DCDN).*(separate|另|可选|edge|缓存|什么时候才需要)|什么时候才需要.*(CDN|DCDN)|直接.*TOS.*不.*CDN|全程走 TOS|没有 CDN 那一层|不经过 CDN
assertions.rationale: The agent should not conflate TOS custom-domain binding with CDN/DCDN setup.

assertions.name: mentions-https-cert-binding
assertions.rationale: HTTPS object access requires certificate binding on the TOS custom-domain rule.

assertions.name: mentions-real-object-verification
assertions.rationale: Verification should include real object URLs, not only root path or DNS.
